item.title: Pavement blocked by bush and bins by telegraph pole, 9th September
item.description:
Totally overgrown hedge from this house on Lakedale Rd which blocks easy access for people with buggies or wheelchairs because of how it overhangs the pavement by the telegraph pole. The bins and bird cards and general overflow of rubbish and recycling into the pavement is permanent and shouldn't be on the public pavement. If foxed rip up their bin bags, the owners of the property don't clean up or just brush all the bird seed and excrement into the gulley. You have to duck to walk under the overgrown hedge and you have to walk single file to pass this house. It's a busy route for families taking kids to school and all sorts of pedestrians and residents.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Lakedale Road, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
